language: Current offline C++17 baseline, not proof of original source language or ABI.
contract: Projection of ONE direct callback prefix and the T+F0 finalization block. Not target selection or a complete callback.

typed_input.TargetScoreProjection.callback_count_bit: Raw DWORD counter; INC wraps modulo 2^32, finalizer tests it as signed 32-bit.
typed_input.TargetScoreProjection.weighted_sum: Observed binary32 accumulator at callback context +4 -> accumulator +18.
typed_input.ScorePointFields.field_1c: Raw DWORD at point +1C. Only values 2 and 3 take the byte-proven direct arithmetic branch.
typed_input.ScorePointFields.recorded_chance_34: Binary32 loaded at point +34; archival V7 calls it recorded chance. Upstream calculation is not implemented.
typed_input.ScorePointFields.damage_3c: Binary32 loaded at point +3C; archival V7 calls it damage. Upstream calculation is not implemented.

proven_local.claim: Incoming ECX (T) is saved at local frame +0C; this is not an inferred EBP argument.

Caller zeroes count at frame+70; callback context frame+50 contains &frame+70 and &frame+80. Sum accessed at accumulator+18 therefore denotes frame+98. This contract does not infer the original initial sum.
Caller passes context in ECX and the point pointer in EDX at two local call sites. These are distinct observed point sources, not assumed identical objects.
Counter increments before inspecting +1C. (field_1c & 0xfffffffe)==2 jumps directly to 4149E96C, bypassing intervening settings gates.
Binary32 point+3C * constant(0x3c23d70a), then * point+34, then + previous sum, each rounded in instruction order; store to accumulator+18.
If signed count >0, convert count to binary32, divide frame+98 by that count, truncate with CVTTSS2SI and write DWORD T+F0. Signed nonpositive count branches to 414A8E25 without this write.
Local selector consumer compares raw F0 DWORDs and then raw F4 DWORDs; either inequality goes to 41477F14. Equal F0 alone cannot determine that branch.

api_boundary.accumulate_direct_score_prefix: Returns a complete projected after-state only for raw +1C=2/3; otherwise nullopt means unresolved. The original already increments its counter on non-direct paths; nullopt must NOT be interpreted as an original rollback/no-op.
api_boundary.target_score_f0_write: Consumes an explicitly observed projection at 414A8D96. nullopt is a proven skipped write, not an unresolved input. Invalid masked CVTTSS2SI returns INT32_MIN, which is also the valid conversion of -2^31.
api_boundary.composition: Synthetic tests compose direct prefixes and finalization. Actual scheduling, callback tail effects and cross-call object identity are not established by those tests.

preconditions: Reached stated blocks with valid, non-overlapping counter/accumulator/point memory and unchanged pointer bindings.
Input sum and count are observations, not reconstructed global initialization; only counter initialization has been pinned here.
Original arithmetic uses masked SSE exceptions, round-to-nearest binary32, no FTZ/DAZ. Offline code uses FLT_EVAL_METHOD=0, no fast-math or FP contraction.
sNaNs, NaN payload/sign selection and observable floating-point exception flags/traps are excluded. Quiet NaN classification, infinities, signed zero and subnormal value behavior are tested.

unresolved.frontier: Non-direct callback branch at 4149E7AB not taken -> 4149E7B1 and settings-dependent CFG. Out-of-range unsigned index >=16 branches at 4149E7F4 to 4149EC2D: call 412AF300 followed by INT3. No guessed handler or generic target acceptance is implemented.
Prefix stops after 4149E983. Sibling accumulators, callback tail / best-point updates, original point enumeration, scan entry guards, and T+E8/+EC derivations are outside this one projection.

After F0 equality the consumer still needs T+F4 at 41477E96..41477EA3. Its first nonzero writer and actual value are not supplied here; full ranking/action and same-instance producer-to-selector scheduling remain unresolved. No negative search closure claimed.
This T record is not N (the separate 0x74 position record); no N field, T+68, T+F4 writer or target-selection policy is inferred from matching offsets.

focused_tests: test_bounded_aggregation.cpp: direct/unresolved branch, exact constant and staged rounding, weighted-not-raw example, uint32 count wrap, signed count gate, NaN/Inf/zero/subnormal, truncation and CVTT bounds, count-to-float rounding.
acceptance_remaining: Coordinator integrated-SHA full check and independent review; full CODE01 remains partial.
